record.locator: Repository consequence of original Section 5.1.2 and LP duality; minimum-completion lifting
record.statement: Put g(0)=0 and g(b)=b^2-b+1 for integers b>=1. For total f, fbs(f)=FC(f)<=g(bs(f)); for arbitrary partial f, completion_fbs(f)=completion_FC(f)<=g(completion_bs(f)).
record.proof_summary: For nonconstant total f, 1<=s<=b=bs and t-1+1/t is increasing on [1,infinity), so the original mixed packing bound gives fbs<=b*(b-1+1/b)=b^2-b+1. Fractional packing/covering LP duality gives FC=fbs. For completions choose a single total extension F minimizing bs. Minimum fbs is at most fbs(F), and apply the total bound to F. When b=0, this extension is constant and both minima are zero.
record.notes: This retains lower-order terms beyond the quadratic upper exponent. It does not change the count of matching completion exponents. Separate minima are never multiplied. A separate agent checked the original Tal statement as well as the deduction; this is not an independent proof audit of the earlier hypergraph theorem. No optimality or novelty claim.
